name: Mighty Moth and the Horrible, Terrible, Awful, No-Good Day!
summary:
Save the day and save your date, one punch at a time!

You’re Mighty Moth, hero of the universe, defender of Cecropolis and helpless romantic! After saving your crush for the millionth time, you finally score a dinner date for 8:00PM. But your excitement is cut short, as the nefarious Shocked Cult has broken into your base and stolen all the galactic gifts you gathered for your date!

Help Mighty Moth beat up cultists, recover her gifts and get to her date before the risotto gets cold!
